# Workplace Pub

> A comprehensive B2B resource and marketing platform for material handling equipment, workplace safety solutions, and industrial operations.

Workplace Pub serves equipment buyers, sellers, and safety professionals in the material handling and workplace safety industries. The platform combines editorial content through digital magazine editions with targeted advertising and marketing services to connect industry suppliers with qualified buyers.

## Key Topics

- Material Handling Equipment
- Workplace Safety
- EHS Compliance
- Machine Guarding
- Automation Equipment
- Supply Chain
- Industrial Operations
- Safety Standards
- Equipment Suppliers
- Audience Targeting
- B2B Marketing
- Industry Leaders
- Buyers Guide
- Construction Safety
- Mailing Lists

## Magazine & Content

- [Home](https://www.workplacepub.com): Homepage for material handling & safety reference tool for equipment buyers and sellers
- [Digital Editions](https://www.workplacepub.com/current-issue): Digital magazine editions and archive for current and past issues
- [Subscribe](https://www.workplacepub.com/subscribe): Magazine subscription for Workplace Material Handling & Safety publication

## Advertising Services

- [Display Advertising](https://www.workplacepub.com/advertising/display-advertising): Display advertising service with geofencing and audience targeting options
- [Email Marketing](https://www.workplacepub.com/advertising/email-marketing): B2B email marketing campaigns targeting material handling & safety professionals
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.workplacepub.com/advertising/social-media-marketing): Social media marketing across Facebook, Twitter, Instagram for industry leads
- [Creative Advertising Solutions](https://www.workplacepub.com/creative-advertising-solutions): Creative services including direct mail, trade shows, and promotional materials
- [Email & Postal List Rental](https://www.workplacepub.com/email-postal-list-rental): Segmented email and postal list rental for B2B material handling marketing
